title: Context Size
description: Maximum tokens in the context window (maps to max_seq_len). Larger values use more memory.

title: Model Data Type
description: Precision for model weights. 'Auto' picks the best type for your hardware. BF16 is recommended on Apple Silicon and Ampere+ GPUs; F16 on older GPUs.

title: Max Concurrent Sequences
description: Maximum sequences processed simultaneously by the scheduler. Increase for higher throughput when serving multiple clients.

title: GPU Layers
description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU/Metal. Leave empty for automatic mapping. Use a single number (e.g. '20') for one GPU, or 'ORD:NUM;...' for multiple GPUs (e.g. '0:20;1:16').

title: In-Situ Quantization (ISQ)
description: Quantize model weights after loading to reduce VRAM. Primarily useful for non-GGUF (safetensors) models; GGUF files are already quantized.

title: Tokenizer Model ID
description: HuggingFace model ID to load the tokenizer from (e.g. 'meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B'). Leave empty to use the tokenizer embedded in the GGUF file.

title: Prefix Cache Size
description: On-device KV-cache slots reserved for prompt prefixes. Repeated identical prefixes skip re-computation. Higher values improve speed but use more VRAM.

title: Disable KV Cache
description: Disabling the KV cache can reduce peak memory usage but will significantly slow down multi-turn conversations.

title: Force CPU Inference
description: Run inference on CPU only, disabling GPU/Metal acceleration. Useful for debugging or on machines without a supported GPU.

title: Timeout
description: Model load and inference timeout in seconds.

title: Auto Unload Model
description: Automatically unload other models when loading a new one.
